senses.gloss: (b. h. אָזַל; √אז; v. אזד)to be gone, to leave; to go.
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Numbers 22:20">Targ. O. Num. XXII, 20</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 10:2:5">Y. Snh. X, 28ᵇ</cite> <he>איזיל חמי וכ׳</he> go, show thy face &c.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 10:2:5">Ib.</cite> <he>לינה מֵיזַל … דנא מיזל וכ׳</he> I will not go … for if I did go &c.

<cite ref="Shabbat 116a:5">Sabb. 116ᵃ</cite> <he>א׳ כתב א׳ וכ׳</he> after the writing is gone, the sacredness of the scroll is gone (after the scroll has become unfit for sacred use, the material has lost its sacred character).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Demai 3:2:4">Y. Dem. III, 23ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>הא אזילא מיבלא וכ׳</he> that man’s load would soon be gone (if each were permitted to take a chip).

Y. Ber. VIII, 12ᵃ הא אזילא ההיא דרב וכ׳ is the decision of Rab and Samuel gone (to be disregarded)? Y. Snh. X, 28ᵃ bot. הא א׳ הדא וכ׳ (ed. Krot. חדא) is that which was received from (is the tradition of) … to be disregarded? Y. Yeb. VIII, 9ᶜ bot. הא אזילא היא וכ׳ (ed. Krot. איזלא, corr. acc.; for היא read הדא or ההיא).—Trnsf. to depart life, die.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Chagigah 2:2:6">Y. Ḥag. II, 77ᵈ</cite> bot. this one committed a sin <he>וא׳ בה</he> and died in it, and the other &c.
M. Kat. 28ᵇ ווי לאזלא woe, for the departed one! Y. Keth. XII, 35ᵃ top אזיל to die, contrad. to אתי to resurrect.—Imperat. usu. זִיל = אזיל.—
<cite ref="Chullin 11b:1">Ḥull. 11ᵇ</cite> <he>ז׳ בתר רובא</he> follow the majority of cases; a. fr.
